payload.name: Extract hobby-origin narratives
payload.description: When a user explains how they got into or started a hobby, interest, or activity, retrieve this skill to ensure the origin story is stored, not just the current preference.
content: During extraction, when a person describes the beginning of a hobby or interest (e.g., who introduced it, a gift, advice, or what inspired them), capture those origin facts as part of the memory candidate, not only the generic current preference.

Store the origin narrative as a durable event or preference memory linked to the person, including the initiator and any specific gift/advice/inspiration mentioned; do not collapse it into a single generic statement about enjoying the activity.

During CRUD, if later messages add or clarify how the person started the activity, update the existing memory with the missing origin details rather than leaving only the preference or current activity summary.

solves: Memory extraction can collapse 'how I started X' into a generic current preference, dropping the initiator, gift, or inspiration needed to answer origin questions. This skill enforces capturing the full origin narrative when a person describes beginning a hobby, and updating earlier memories when later messages add such details. It applies to future origin explanations, not to simple statements of current enjoyment.
